name: qwen38_split
description: Optional llama-server split of Qwen3.8-27B over an OpenAI-compatible API. Set QWEN38_SPLIT_HOST to its base URL. It is never selected automatically: it takes part in a fallback only when your own config names it. Context is 4096 tokens when launched with -c 4096.

env_vars.name: QWEN38_SPLIT_HOST
env_vars.description: Base URL of the Qwen3.8-27B llama-server split (default: http://127.0.0.1:8081)
